stories.title: Scientists who put faith in technology less likely to take climate action
stories.summary: A London School of Economics study found that scientists who believe technology will largely solve the climate crisis are less likely to take civic action on the issue. The report says these 'techno-optimists' are 23% less likely than more sceptical peers to sign petitions or join protests, raising concern that faith in unproven solutions may displace societal change.
